The DOI request resolved to https://journal.kace.re.kr/_common/do.php?a=full&b=&bidx=4492&aidx=50044 with HTTP 200; a direct GET of that landing page also returned HTTP 200. Inspected the article text, outgoing links and download controls: no supplementary data/code/materials files or repository links were identified. The PDF, PubReader and ePub controls are article formats. The additional-PDF handler has no target file. Mendeley and Excel appear only as citation-export options.

notes:
Checked on 2026-10-09. Read the complete saved markdown, including references and author biographies (PDF pp. 1-10, journal pp. 40-49); checked PDF text on pp. 1, 5, 9 and 10, URI annotations throughout, and embedded-file inventory (none). The paper has no appendix, supplement reference, data/code/materials availability statement, preregistration, repository URL, or offer to provide data on request. The quoted Section 3.1 paragraph concerns informed consent, intended data use and preventing personal identification during analysis; it does not establish public or restricted data access. Task instructions and the scoring rubric are described in Sections 3.1-3.2 within the article, not in a separate materials deposit. Both data_and_code URLs in the screening form are empty. Bibliographic links concern cited papers, not deposits for c075.

All four named repository APIs were searched by the English and Korean titles and first-author names, with additional English subtitle and author-token searches. There were 23 successful HTTP-200 search requests; the two initial Zenodo requests returned HTTP 400 for size=100 and succeeded when retried with size=25. The only nonzero result count was two unrelated DataCite records, reviewed and excluded as described in searches. OSF's supplied endpoint filters node titles, including when an author name is entered; it is not a comprehensive contributor search. No paper-specific deposit was identified, so there were no repository file lists or participant-data columns to inspect. No login, account creation or access request was attempted.

No public data were confirmed for S1 or S2 (the same participants). Public data therefore cannot resolve final.open_items concerning initial/assigned/excluded counts or separate idea counts from per-idea mean quality by arm. The paper already prints total-score means, SDs and analyzed counts by arm in Table 4, but no participant-level records, idea texts or idea-level scores were located to compute additional person-level summaries or diversity measures. Round-1 assignment and rater background also remain unresolved. This status records that no deposit was found in the checked sources; it does not assert that the authors have no underlying data.
